source: I can’t bear my own reflection. Wearing the yellow belt and tassels of the Science Advisor of Aslandia. A mother soon, too. I should’ve been faster… Fungaki says I’m too hard on myself. I added my knowhow about fertilization and scientific method to chart the path towards a cure for Blue Death, which returned with the mosquitoes every summer. The mushroom paste antibiotic is not totally effective, a roughly 70% recovery rate – incredible, though, with our limited resources. I should’ve been faster… That… that snake… that scheming witch Seece and her Star Worshippers! They delayed our testing when they demanded to know what “poisons” we were brewing. Spreading lies and fear when the people needed hope. That brainwashed drunk Warek stormed in and smashed our grow-lab a year ago, setting us back months. I would’ve strangled Seece by now if it wasn’t for Fungaki. But I should’ve been faster… Dad. I should’ve made this antibiotic long ago – expanding the lab, testing more rapidly, ignoring tribal drama. I should’ve been ready for when you started wheezing… I miss you so much. My best friend. What do I do? Your grandchild will be amazing, just like you. I promise.

source: Furion Captain: My Queen, the treaty states…
target: 弗里昂隊長：女王陛下，條約明定……

source: Furion Captain: Forgive me. Aslandians number 43 men, and 52 women and children. Less than 20 of those men are of fighting ability. I can ensure destruction with 25 Furions, 5 Crossbowmen and 2 bomb canoes.
target: 弗里昂隊長：請恕罪。阿斯蘭迪亞有四十三名男子，五十二名婦孺。男子中，能作戰的不到二十人。二十五名弗里昂戰士、五名弩手，加上兩艘炸彈獨木舟，就能保證全殲。

source: Herring Gull: Need two more twig, some more leaf and then… Aaah – what this?
target: 銀鷗：還差兩根樹枝，再多一點葉子，然後……啊——這什麼？

source: Furion Captain: Shoot that gull tearing the sail!
target: 弗里昂隊長：射下那隻撕船帆的海鷗！

source: Herring Gull: Errrr…. Mmmph.… Errraaaah!
target: 銀鷗：呃——嗯唔……呃啊——！

source: Herring Gull: I see this before… buttbiting seal hide, hide, hide in water. Then sploosh! Jump and eat swimming gull. These human act like seal… hide and want to hurt my mushroom friend…
target: 銀鷗：我看過這個……咬屁股海豹躲、躲、躲在水裡。然後噗通！跳出來，吃游泳的海鷗。這些人類像海豹……躲起來，要害我的蘑菇朋友……

source: Herring Gull: Got! Got piece! Ripped soft red leaf and I take – Ah!
target: 銀鷗：拿到！拿到一片！撕下軟軟紅葉子，我帶走——啊！

source: Herring Gull: Aaaah! Close one – they shoot fast sticks. Stupid human buttbiters, hah!
target: 銀鷗：啊——！好險，他們射快快的棍子。笨人類咬屁股怪，哈！

source: Herring Gull: Cruel humans not leave with big red floating nest? Why staying on rock island?
target: 銀鷗：壞人類沒跟紅色大浮巢走？為什麼留在石頭島？

source: Old Seagull: A-a-ack!
target: 老海鷗：啊、啊、嘎！

source: Old Seagull: Aa-acka!
target: 老海鷗：啊——嘎！

source: Fungaki: We owe you our lives, my feathery friend. Go ahead, gulp ‘em down the gullet, all the fish you like.
target: 芬加奇：羽毛朋友，我們欠你一條命。吃吧，通通吞下去，想吃多少魚都行。

source: Old Seagull: Aaaa–ack!
target: 老海鷗：啊——嘎！

source: Old Seagull: Ackaaa!
target: 老海鷗：嘎啊！

source: Fungaki: You should’ve seen it, I rallied Aslandia – me, the fuel maker. We decided to use everything we had to take our stand. The men worked in the boats during the day, clumping large, sprawling patches of algae around the perimeter of the village. The women helped me cook barrels of my new, concentrated fuel. The children took all the fish, guts, and cooked blubber we had and mashed them together into a stinky paste you would’ve loved.
target: 芬加奇：你真該看看，我召集了整個阿斯蘭迪亞——我，一個做燃料的。我們決定傾盡所有，奮力一搏。白天，男人們划船，把大片藻類聚到村子周圍。女人們幫我熬製一桶桶新式濃縮燃料。孩子們則把我們所有的魚、內臟和熟脂肪，搗成你一定會愛死的臭糊。

source: Fungaki: If you hadn’t brought me that shred of red silk two days ago, we would’ve been fish food. We thought Aryth’s goons were long gone after taking my world. My wife Daneve… wasn’t my world enough? I suppose they were waiting to strike, and we were foolish to trust their so-called “treaty.”
target: 芬加奇：要不是你兩天前帶來那片紅絲綢，我們早就成魚飼料了。我們以為，艾瑞絲的走狗奪走我的全世界後，就早已離去。我的妻子丹妮芙……我的全世界，還不夠嗎？看來他們一直等著下手，我們竟蠢到相信那份所謂的「條約」。

source: Fungaki: You’re right, old buddy – time to celebrate.
target: 芬加奇：你說得對，老朋友，該慶祝了。

source: Fungaki: We were ready when they attacked last night. As their boats approached, they slowed in the algae clumps and we lit ‘em up! You must’ve heard the two huge explosions… some sort of weapon to destroy our cement buildings I imagine. Their warriors jumped overboard into a feeding frenzy, and those who attempted to crawl out were met by our harpoons and knives. We didn’t lose a single life, can you believe it?
target: 芬加奇：昨晚他們進攻時，我們已準備好了。船一靠近，就被藻叢拖慢，我們立刻點火！你一定聽見那兩聲巨響……我猜是某種用來炸毀水泥建築的武器。他們的戰士跳下船，掉進瘋狂覓食的獸群，試圖爬上岸的人，則迎上我們的魚叉與刀。我們一個人也沒死，你能相信嗎？

source: Fungaki: During the night, the seal hunters would float out and soak my fuel into the algae, while the oystermen would chum the water with the fishy paste to draw in crocodiles and sharks and sea beasts of all sorts.
target: 芬加奇：夜裡，海豹獵人漂出去，把我的燃料浸進藻叢。採蠔人則把那股魚腥糊撒進水裡，引來鱷魚、鯊魚，還有各式海獸。
